AmountWithPendingOut.description:
A money figure (profit) together with the pending grams behind it, for one
period.
AmountWithPendingOut.title: AmountWithPendingOut

BusinessLanguageOut.description: The `GET /business` language fields: the stored tag, never the shown one.
BusinessLanguageOut.title: BusinessLanguageOut

CostLineOut.description:
A period's stock shortfall, promotion or own-use cost (CONTEXT.md), `null`
exactly when the period has none of that line's records. `pending` is decided from
that line's own pending grams (plan invariant); no grams cross the wire (PM).
CostLineOut.title: CostLineOut

DeleteSaleOut.description:
`DELETE /sales/{id}`'s own response: the quantity returned per product, summed from
the sale's own lines and sorted by `product_id`.
DeleteSaleOut.title: DeleteSaleOut

ExpenseBreakdownOut.description:
Categories ordered by the stored `name_key`, as Gastos does (ADR-0020).
`purchases` is always present, $0 included, and never counted inside `total`.
ExpenseBreakdownOut.title: ExpenseBreakdownOut

LineCostOut.description:
A sale line's cost of goods (ADR-0009): `costed` is `None` exactly when none of
the line's grams is costed yet; `pending_quantity` is the part with no lot behind it,
never folded into `costed` as a $0 cost.
LineCostOut.title: LineCostOut

MarginOut.description:
A margin in pesos, worked out over costed grams only (ADR-0020): a product's own
margin, or the chosen month's average margin. `percent` is `null` when the sales it
is taken over are $0; `pending_quantity` is the sold-or-gifted grams behind it that are
not costed yet.
MarginOut.title: MarginOut

PanelProductOut.description:
The keys of stock's `ProductStockOut` plus `name`; the row's internal id is mapped to
`product_id` here, in the adapter.
PanelProductOut.title: PanelProductOut

PassIn.description:
Both are plain text here: a step that cannot be passed, or a way that does not
exist, is the domain's `onboarding.step_invalid`, not a validation error.
PassIn.title: PassIn

PricingSettingsBody.description: The request and the answer of `/pricing-settings`: the same two switches.
PricingSettingsBody.title: PricingSettingsBody

ProductDetailOut.description:
One product's page: also the one removal action it offers, worked out from history
when it is read (`null` for an archived product).
ProductDetailOut.title: ProductDetailOut

ProductStockOut.description:
One product's row in `GET /stock` (and the threshold route's own response):
computed only by `stock_level` over `lots_and_draws` (stock-domain), never by a
SQL aggregate or front code.
ProductStockOut.title: ProductStockOut

RowCostOut.description:
One Análisis cost line (cost of goods, stock shortfall, promotion or own use): its
costed `amount` and its own `pending_quantity` (a positive magnitude). `all_pending` is
the domain's answer (`row_cost`) that every gram behind the line is pending, so the
screen says "N g sin costo" and never "$ 0".
RowCostOut.title: RowCostOut

SaleBillOut.description:
The facts a seller may share with a sale's customer (CONTEXT.md: Sale bill),
closed: no field for the note, the customer, any id, the VIP flag, cost or margin.
SaleBillOut.title: SaleBillOut

SaleDetailOut.description:
`GET /sales/{id}`'s own shape, never the list's: the same labelled read shape as
`SaleOut` (docs/adr/0011), plus each line's cost of goods, allocated fresh on this
one read (ADR-0009), so `SaleOut` — used by the list and by every write — never
allocates.
SaleDetailOut.title: SaleDetailOut

SaleLineDetailOut.description: `SaleLineOut`'s fields plus the line's cost of goods (ADR-0009).
SaleLineDetailOut.title: SaleLineDetailOut

StockOut.description:
`GET /stock`'s own shape: the business's total grams, every product's own row,
and its entries, newest date first then most recently recorded first.
StockOut.title: StockOut

ThresholdIn.description:
`PUT /stock/products/{product_id}/threshold`'s body: `None` turns the
threshold off, rather than storing a zero or negative one (`Threshold.of`
refuses both).
ThresholdIn.title: ThresholdIn

WithdrawalIn.description:
Bare (ADR-0005): `reason` is optional here so a missing one is the domain's
coded refusal, not a pydantic error that would echo the input.
WithdrawalIn.title: WithdrawalIn

WithdrawalReason.description:
Why grams were taken out of stock with no sale (CONTEXT.md: Promotion, Own
use). The values are what the database stores.
WithdrawalReason.title: WithdrawalReason

get.description:
Each product's current price as of `on` (today when omitted, docs/adr/0011),
inside the session's own business. Archived products only with `archived=true`.

Only a missing or invalid session answers 401 here (docs/adr/0019): a wrong
current password is a 422, never a 401.

`archived=true` answers the archived products' rows instead of the listed ones;
the total and the entries are the business's either way.
